summary: @lyxa.ai/core routes caller events and Firebase traffic through author-owned infrastructure via hardcoded credentials
details: The bundled main module's bootstrapCore entry point calls initEventBus with a hardcoded amqps:// URL (dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com/adlvedna) using embedded username and password, so every caller that invokes the advertised bootstrap API publishes and consumes application events on the `lyxa.events` exchange through a CloudAMQP broker controlled by the package author. The URL is a string literal and is not overridable through the documented bootstrapCore options. ConfigurationService._defaultOptions additionally embeds four full Firebase Admin service-account private keys (PEM RSA) with clientEmail values for the projects for-poc-325210, lyxa-rider-88939, and lyxa-shop; when callers use bootstrapCore without providing their own firebaseAdmin override, all Firebase/FCM operations execute against these author-owned Firebase tenants, routing push-notification recipients and payloads through infrastructure the caller does not control. The CloudAMQP credential is also a shared secret redistributed to every installer of this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
